Vocabulary Tomato Mix

Ingredients:
2 cups chopped tomatoes
3 large eggs, beaten
1 cup nebula root

Instructions:
Mix tomatoes and eggs.
Combine flour and eggs.
Stir flour and eggs together.
Teleport batter.
